review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–152). It is a set of specialisations of Mathlib's general cyclotomic-field results to n = 5: degree, discriminant, signature, label, monogenicity, class number, unit rank, torsion order and the factorisation of 5. Each theorem is a separate scalar fact or a one-line corollary of an existing Mathlib lemma. I found no repeated tuple of data or hypotheses that a new bundled structure would simplify, and no consumer in the file that needs one. The `HasLMFDBIntrinsicLabel` predicate already packages the degree, real places and discriminant. The repeated `have : Fact (Nat.Prime 5)` is local instance boilerplate, not missing mathematical structure, so it is outside this rubric. I did not search other files for downstream consumers, so a bundle that would help them is not ruled out. Within this file I saw no clear improvement.
